results.releaseNotes: We have fixed all the pesky bugs, optimised the green reading algorithm and increased the overall speed of the app. Enjoy letting the app read your putts!
results.description:
The augmented reality putting app and ball tracker for the perfect putt every time! 

For the seasoned and beginner golfer alike. The coach implementing cutting-edge technology in their lessons. Or the revered content creator in the golfing community. Putt Vision is essential to simply doing it better. Because what’s better than knowing the EXACT break?

Putt Vision implements the early 2000’s PC game feature, Tiger Vision, in real life. On the green, using AR technology. What was once a virtual PC game feature is now the world's most cutting edge green reading technology – with a twist of Shot Tracer for every golfer using their iPhone or iPad.

The Putt Vision app accurately predicts the perfect putting line for any break and distance using real time topology mapping and augmented reality.

State-of-the-art augmented reality displays holographic information onto your phone's display, helping you make the perfect putt!

For GOLFERS: Be prepared. Use Putt Vision for practice and pre-tournament rounds to map out your green sheets.

For TEACHING PROS: Train better than the rest. Use Putt Vision for a state-of-the-art putt learning experience for your students. AR green reading and real-time putt tracking create a learning experience like no other.

For CONTENT CREATORS: Add jaw-dropping augmented reality and 3D content to your GolfVlogs and social media posts.

For INDOOR PUTTING: Use any ordinary projector to project the putt line onto your indoor putting mat and track the ball in real-time via HDMI or wireless connection from your phone.

VR and AR Headset Support: For a fully immersive experience, the world's most interactive virtual putting practice features an optional VR/AR mode.

Features:

► Green reading and break line prediction.
► Real-time ball tracking for your putts.
► Custom holographic heads up display.
► Add custom augmented reality text on any surface.
► Metric and imperial units supported.

► The cherry on top: Shot Tracer in augmented reality!

Key Putt Vision Options:

• Speed Zone
• Terrain Arrows
• Aim Point
• Undulation Grid
• Info Board
• Hole Marker
• Aim Line
• Break Line

Transform your putting experience today. Download now!

 
App Store videos created in partnership with Fontana Golf Club, Austria. Visit https://fontana.at/ for more details on golf in Austria.
